Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client (business owner) using the GBReplAi dashboard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the client entity.

businessName.description: The name of the client's business, obtained from their Google profile.

email.description: The client's email address, obtained from their Google account.

credits.description: The number of credits the client has available for using AI-powered features.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the client's account was created.

autoReplyEnabled.description: Indicates whether auto-reply is enabled for the client's reviews.

responseTone.description: The desired tone for AI-generated responses (e.g., 'professional', 'friendly').

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a Google Business Profile review.

id.description: Unique identifier for the review entity.

rating.description: The star rating given in the review (e.g., 1-5).

text.description: The text content of the review.

timestamp.description: The timestamp indicating when the review was submitted.

response.description: The response to the review, either manually entered or AI-generated.

aiGenerated.description: Indicates whether the response was generated by AI.

CreditTransaction.title: CreditTransaction
CreditTransaction.description: Represents a transaction that modifies a client's credit balance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the credit transaction entity.

amount.description: The amount of credits added or subtracted in the transaction (positive or negative).

timestamp.description: The timestamp indicating when the transaction occurred.

description.description: A description of the transaction (e.g., 'Initial free credits', 'AI response generated').

definition.description: Stores client profiles. Uses path-based ownership for individual client data.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The unique ID of the client, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

definition.description: Stores reviews associated with a specific client. Enforces path-based ownership.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The unique ID of the client who owns the review.

params.name: reviewId
params.description: The unique ID of the review.

definition.description: Stores credit transaction data. Includes 'clientId' for authorization independence.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: The unique ID of the credit transaction.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the GBReplAi dashboard application, focusing on secure and efficient management of client data, reviews, and credit transactions. The structure prioritizes authorization independence by avoiding hierarchical `get()` calls in security rules, and supports QAPs via structural segregation and membership models where necessary.

*   **Clients:** The `clients` collection stores user profiles. Path-based ownership is utilized via the `clients/{clientId}` path.
*   **Reviews:** Reviews are stored in a subcollection `clients/{clientId}/reviews`. This structure ensures that reviews are directly associated with their respective clients, enforcing ownership and simplifying data retrieval for a specific client.
*   **Credit Transactions:** Credit transactions are stored in a top-level `credit_transactions` collection, and include the `clientId`. A top-level collection is used so rules can ensure that only the user can write their own transactions. The rules will require that the `clientId` field matches the requesting user's `uid` field to grant write access.

This structure adheres to Authorization Independence by denormalizing authorization data where needed. For example, the `clientId` field in `credit_transactions` enables secure `list` operations and prevents unauthorized access to transaction data. Path-based ownership (`clients/{clientId}/reviews`) simplifies security rules for reviews. The segregation of `clients` data from `credit_transactions` helps to clearly define access control policies.

The chosen structure supports QAPs (Rules are not Filters) by clearly defining ownership and access rights at each level. Path-based ownership for `clients` and `reviews` allows for efficient and secure data retrieval without relying on complex filtering in rules. The denormalized `clientId` field in `credit_transactions` facilitates secure `list` operations, ensuring that only authorized users can access transaction data associated with their account.
